comments.body: The `exception` mode intentionally throws from the fixture `Test-StyleGuideGenerator.ps1`, which means the proof body will terminate before it can emit the controlled `Generator pass 1/2 failed.` diagnostics. As written, the test expects the pass-failure message for all non-`success` modes, so the `exception` case will fail. Fix by handling `exception` separately (e.g., assert non-zero exit + no revision publication, and match the exception text), or remove `exception` from the modes list if it’s not a supported/meaningful behavior to validate.

Assert-AllowedPathSet’s return shape changed from a forced array (`@(...)`) to a pipeline return. This can return a scalar string when exactly one path is observed, which is easy to mis-handle at call sites (e.g., `.Count` semantics differ between `string` and `string[]`). If callers rely on consistent array semantics, return an explicit array (e.g., `return @($listObservedPaths | Sort-Object -CaseSensitive)`).
